rationale: Motor vehicle collision resulting in vehicle damage and injury to the policyholder, clearly covered under auto insurance.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan was rear-ended on Route 9 at approximately 8:15am yesterday; vehicle is totaled with severe trunk and cabin damage from an unbraking impact at ~35 mph. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist; other party's insurance information is on file with the police report. High severity due to total loss vehicle and injuries; prompt investigation and medical coordination recommended.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling at ~35 mph with no braking; entire trunk crushed into back seat
